summary: Tested Lumera Phase 1 prescription enhancements (drug interactions, Whisper transcribe, private doctor notes, tapering schedule, ABHA linking, mic UI). Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass after a small ObjectId fix in create_prescription. Frontend: PrescriptionWriter page renders cleanly, all new UI elements (mic buttons x4, Check Drug Interactions, Tapering toggle, Private Doctor Notes, ABHA checkbox) present, Check Drug Interactions wired end-to-end and rendered a HIGH severity Warfarin+Aspirin alert inline. No console/page errors.

minor.issue: Initially returned 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId being added to the dict by motor's insert_one() and then serialized in the response. Fixed by inserting a copy of the dict (insert_one(prescription_data.copy())). All subsequent calls return 200.

action_items: Optional: consider running drug interaction check asynchronously (it takes ~5-10s per request because of gpt-4o-mini). Currently blocking the UI thread but UX has a spinner.
Consider returning a sanitized prescription record (drop _id explicitly via response_model) instead of relying on .copy(). This pattern repeats elsewhere — easy regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: ObjectId leak risk: server.py uses dict mutations with motor's insert_one() in multiple places. Recommend a helper `clean_doc(doc)` that strips _id or always insert a .copy(). Already saw this break create_prescription.
send_whatsapp_message is awaited inline inside create_prescription (HTTP path) — if Twilio is slow/unreachable, the prescription request will block. Consider BackgroundTasks.
/api/prescriptions/transcribe: 25MB cap is fine, but no per-user rate limit; could be abused. Consider adding @limiter.limit.

Drug interaction prompt parses model JSON manually; falls back gracefully but should also strip leading whitespace before markdown fence check (currently `cleaned.startswith('```json')` only). Already handled by .strip() — minor.
PrescriptionWriter.js (no testid for past notes toggle content was checked — all critical testids present and unique).
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (insert_one(prescription_data.copy()) to avoid ObjectId leak in response)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke test passed, all elements rendered, drug-interactions integration verified end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Created appointment + client 'TEST_Phase1 Patient' with random unique phone numbers. ABHA id 12345678901234 attached to one test client via PUT /api/clients/{phone}/abha. Two prescriptions created against the seeded appointment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 endpoints verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_prescription_phase1.py covers: drug-interactions (4 cases incl. Warfarin+Aspirin), transcribe (3 error paths — 422 no file, 400 empty, 401 unauth), private-notes (empty + after-create history), create_prescription with new fields (private_doctor_notes, tapering, linked_to_abha false/true), and /link-abha (400 no ABHA, 200 after ABHA set, auto-link on create). The create-prescription ObjectId bug was fixed in server.py.
rca of the issue: POST /api/prescriptions returned 500 because motor's insert_one(prescription_data) mutated the dict by inserting the generated ObjectId under '_id', and the endpoint then returned that same dict in the response. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → TypeError. Reproduction: create any prescription via the API. Mitigation applied: insert a shallow copy via insert_one(prescription_data.copy()). All 15 backend tests pass after the fix.
